# reselling_load_balancer_service (Resource)

A service (listener) of a load balancer: a port it listens on (`tcp`, `http`, or `https` with TLS termination) and how it forwards to the targets. Unset optional values take the platform defaults. Import with `load_balancer_id/service_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "reselling_load_balancer_service" "https" {
  load_balancer_id      = reselling_load_balancer.web.id
  name                  = "https"
  protocol              = "https"
  listen_port           = 443
  target_port           = 80
  health_check_protocol = "http"
  health_check_path     = "/health"
  redirect_to_https     = true
  certificate_ids       = [reselling_load_balancer_certificate.shop.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `listen_port` (Number)
- `load_balancer_id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `protocol` (String) `tcp`, `http` or `https`.
- `target_port` (Number)

### Optional

- `algorithm` (String) `roundrobin`, `leastconn` or `source`.
- `certificate_ids` (Set of String) Certificates (`reselling_load_balancer_certificate`) served by an https service.
- `default_certificate_id` (String) Certificate served when no SNI name matches.
- `forward_headers` (Boolean) Send X-Forwarded-For and X-Forwarded-Proto.
- `health_check_expected_status` (String) Expected status codes such as `200`, `200,204` or `2xx`.
- `health_check_fall` (Number) Failed checks until unhealthy (1-10).
- `health_check_interval` (Number) Seconds between checks (1-300).
- `health_check_path` (String) Path for http health checks, for example `/health`.
- `health_check_protocol` (String) `tcp` or `http`.
- `health_check_rise` (Number) Successful checks until healthy (1-10).
- `health_check_timeout` (Number) Seconds (1-60).
- `proxy_protocol` (String) `none`, `v1` or `v2`.
- `redirect_to_https` (Boolean) Redirect http to https.
- `sticky_cookie_name` (String) Name of the sticky cookie.
- `sticky_sessions` (Boolean) Pin a client to one target with a cookie (http/https).
- `timeout_client` (Number) Seconds (1-3600).
- `timeout_connect` (Number) Seconds (1-300).
- `timeout_server` (Number) Seconds (1-3600).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import reselling_load_balancer_service.https <load_balancer_id>/<service_id>
```
